magic.mushokutenseiorigin.book_page:
Zenith Greyrat's Magic Book

Water Ball
Water magic

Learn the chant to unlock this spell.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.natur:
Magic Primer

Magic uses mana to affect matter. Learn a formula, then control creation, size, speed and release. Check your reserves before casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.eleme:
Four Elements

Offensive magic uses water, fire, wind and earth. Water also includes ice and weather. This primer teaches one basic projectile per element.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ranks:
Ranks

Beginner, intermediate, advanced, saint, king, emperor and god rank describe formula difficulty, not overall combat ability. Master the basics first.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.metho:
Casting

Chants guide a formula. Shortened, omitted and silent forms also exist. Circles have other uses. Here, learning a chant unlocks instant casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.pract:
Practice

Load learned spells in Magic Knowledge. Select one with the wheel. Hold Cast to repeat. Each release costs mana and must wait for its cooldown.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.safet:
Safety

Rest when mana runs low. Successful sleep restores mana. Basic shots vanish on impact. Avoid allies. Combined and sustained magic require further study.

magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.statu:
Added effects

Water: 60% Wet.
Ice: 80% Frozen.
Fire: 80% burning.

Duration: 5s per rank, up to 35s. Reapplication refreshes duration. Wet has no added effect. Barriers block added effects too.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.maint:
Maintaining magic

Hold Cast to pay and extend after each cooldown. Shields regain capacity 8.

Water Shield and Heat Island require standing still. Releasing or moving ends maintenance. Recast replaces it. Switching spells keeps existing effects.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.water:
Water Cannon
Intermediate
Requires: Water Arrow
Mana: 8
Cooldown: 1.5s

Flies 18 blocks. Creature hit: 7 damage and 0.8 knockback, no explosion. Block hit: 3x3x3 damage volume and 1x1x1 terrain blast. Only blocks harvestable with wooden tools and drops can break.

Water Splash
Intermediate
Requires: Water Ball
Mana: 8
Cooldown: 3s

Aim up to 12 blocks. Visible creatures within radius 6 take 1 damage and become Wet for 100s on successful damage.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.icicl:
Icicle Field
Intermediate
Requires: Ice Smash, Heat Island
Mana: 14
Cooldown: 6s

Aim up to 12 blocks. Visible creatures within radius 6 take 5 damage. Wet victims lose Wet and are encased in solid 3x3x3 temporary ice for 6s. Existing blocks are preserved.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ex_fl:
Ex-Flame
Intermediate
Requires: Fireball
Mana: 12
Cooldown: 2s

A 2-block fireball flies 20 blocks. Creature hit: 8 fire damage, no explosion. Block hit: 3x3x3 damage volume, 2x2x2 harvestable-block blast, and vanilla spreading fire.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.sonic:
Sonic Boom
Intermediate
Requires: Wind Ball
Mana: 8
Cooldown: 1.5s

A 3-wide, 1-high blade flies 15 blocks, piercing creatures. Each victim takes 5 damage and 1.0 knockback once per shot. Stops at walls or range limit.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.stone:
Stone Cannon
Intermediate
Requires: Rock Bullet
Mana: 10
Cooldown: 2s

Tap and release V for 10 damage. Hold to inject mana at 10/second initially, increasing linearly by 10/second each second. Only actual total paid mana (including the base 10) is shown below the crosshair; every extra 10 mana adds 1 damage with no extra cap. Remainders cost mana but add no damage. Release or depletion fires at speed 2, range 24. Pierces creatures, not walls. Interruptions refund mana.

Mana: 8
Cooldown: 3s

Press V to fire a ray up to 12 blocks with no target required. Its first creature hit takes 4 damage and raises a 1×3×1 ice pillar underfoot; a block hit also raises the pillar. The pillar lasts 10 seconds and launches creatures. Misses disappear. Only fills air.

Cooldown: 1s

Intermediate
Requires: Ex-Flame
Mana: 16
Cooldown: 4s

Press V to fire a ray up to 12 blocks. A creature or block hit triggers a power-4 explosion equivalent to one vanilla TNT, with fire generation enabled. Misses disappear. Damage, knockback, terrain destruction and drops follow vanilla explosion rules, replacing fixed damage and stone-tool restrictions.
